#!/bin/bash
# The gaps of the diagnostic of the inserts (bench-report.md of
# feat/posting-edge-index, "Huecos del diagnóstico", pre-registered on
# 2026-11-28 by the user's order): measures only. Every pass over an index
# runs on an APFS clone of its own, removed after the pass; the 10M index and
# the 100k one are never opened. The binary is built before (gaps.test, from
# the diagnostic branch with bench_diag_gaps_test.go); nothing here builds.
# Timed: marker, idle wait, caffeinate.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
X=$S/diag
G=$X/gaps
D=$HOME/Documents/datasets/wikidpr-10m-e5-inplace.bin
P=adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge
mkdir -p $G

printf 'the gaps of the diagnostic of the inserts (diag/gaps.sh), timed, since %s for about three quarters of an hour; taken down by the experiments session\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" > $S/timed-session.lock

hid_idle() { ioreg -c IOHIDSystem | awk '/HIDIdleTime/ {print int($NF/1000000000); exit}'; }
date "+== %H:%M:%S waiting for 900 s of idle (now $(hid_idle) s)"
while [ "$(hid_idle)" -lt 900 ]; do sleep 30; done
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S idle for $(hid_idle) s"

clear_clones() {
  find /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/diag/gaps -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
}

# run <size> <name> <test> [NAME=value ...]
run() {
  local size=$1 name=$2 test=$3
  shift 3
  local C=$G/$size/$name
  local free=$(df -k $X | tail -n 1 | awk '{print int($4/1048576)}')
  if [ "$free" -lt 10 ]; then
    date "+== %H:%M:%S $size $name NOT RUN: $free GiB free, under 10"
    return
  fi
  mkdir -p $C
  if [ $size = 100k ]; then
    cp -c -R $X/i100k/index $C/index || exit 3
    # Warm: every file of the clone read once before the index opens.
    find $C/index -type f -exec cat {} + > /dev/null
    set -- PE_ROWS=100000 "$@"
  else
    cp -c -R $S/grow10m/index $C/index || exit 3
    # The store read once (7 GB); the vectors (30.7 GB) do not fit in the
    # file cache next to it, and stay as cold as a new clone is.
    find $C/index/lsm -type f -exec cat {} + > /dev/null
  fi
  date "+== %H:%M:%S $size $name: $test $* (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
  (cd $X/src/$P && exec env PE_DATASET=$D PE_DIR=$C/index PE_OUT=$C/result.json "$@" \
    $X/gaps.test -test.run "^$test\$" -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $C/run.log 2>&1) &
  local pid=$!
  python3 -I -B $X/monitor.py $pid $C/monitor.jsonl 2 > $C/monitor.err 2>&1 &
  wait $pid
  echo "$size $name exit $?"
  wait
  clear_clones
}

passes() { # size ef seconds vectors plans
  local size=$1 ef=$2 seconds=$3 vectors=$4 plans=$5
  run $size q1 TestDiagQueries PE_EF=$ef PE_QTHREADS=1 PE_CALLERS=0 PE_SECONDS=$seconds
  run $size q8 TestDiagQueries PE_EF=$ef PE_QTHREADS=8 PE_CALLERS=0 PE_SECONDS=$seconds
  run $size i8 TestDiagQueries PE_EF=$ef PE_QTHREADS=0 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_SECONDS=$seconds PE_NVECTORS=$vectors
  run $size qi1 TestDiagQueries PE_EF=$ef PE_QTHREADS=1 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_SECONDS=$seconds PE_NVECTORS=$vectors
  run $size qi8 TestDiagQueries PE_EF=$ef PE_QTHREADS=8 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_SECONDS=$seconds PE_NVECTORS=$vectors
  run $size degree TestDiagDegree PE_DEGREE=1
  run $size search-marks-a TestDiagSearch PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=$plans
  run $size search-nomarks-a TestDiagSearch PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=$plans PE_NODELETED=1
  run $size search-marks-b TestDiagSearch PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=$plans
  run $size search-nomarks-b TestDiagSearch PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=$plans PE_NODELETED=1
}

# The tables, with no index.
mkdir -p $G/tables
date "+== %H:%M:%S tables (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
(cd $X/src/$P && PE_OUT=$G/tables/result.json \
  PE_TABLES=125000:26813:9033,12500000:144798:28235,125000:144798:28235,12500000:26813:9033 PE_TABLETHREADS=1,8 \
  $X/gaps.test -test.run '^TestDiagTables$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $G/tables/run.log 2>&1)
echo "tables exit $?"

# The reads, over a clone of the file of the vectors of the 10M index.
mkdir -p $G/reads
cp -c $S/grow10m/index/main.postingedge.d/vectors-5.f32 $G/reads/vectors.clone || exit 3
date "+== %H:%M:%S reads (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
(cd $X/src/$P && PE_FILE=$G/reads/vectors.clone PE_OUT=$G/reads/result.json PE_RECORD=3072 PE_READS=20000 PE_READSECONDS=3 \
  $X/gaps.test -test.run '^TestDiagReads$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $G/reads/run.log 2>&1)
echo "reads exit $?"
rm -f /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/diag/gaps/reads/vectors.clone

# The point of 0.95 of the 100k index, untimed, and its passes.
run 100k point TestDiagPoint PE_POINT=$G/100k/point.json
EF100=$(python3 -I -B -c "import json; print(json.load(open('$G/100k/point.json'))['ef'])")
date "+== %H:%M:%S the 100k index reaches 0.95 at ef $EF100"
if [ -n "$EF100" ]; then
  passes 100k $EF100 20 40000 20000
fi
# The 10M index reaches 0.95 at ef 24 (TestNightPoints, 2026-11-28).
passes 10m 24 90 60000 8000

date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S done (idle $(hid_idle) s)" | tee $G/end.txt
pmset -g log 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+ \+[0-9]+ (Sleep|Wake|DarkWake)' | tail -n 5 > $G/pmset-sleep-wake.txt
rm -f /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/timed-session.lock
